{{Top}}
'''Crash webbing''' was a safety feature in many different [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that held occupants in their seats. The [[Shroud (starship)|''Shroud'']], [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], and ''[[Rock Dragon]]'' used this technology.
